facts.fact: The World Bank's Mali Digital Economy Diagnostic states that pilot projects (Mali Health Data Project) to digitize patient files within a few community health centers and to develop an electronic health record on cell phones, run with external technical partners, were not able to succeed for lack of funding and institutional support; it gives no count and no date, so the date is the report's published date.
facts.system: Mali Health Data Project (electronic health record pilots)

facts.fact: The World Bank diagnostic states that health-sector pilots including the patient-file and electronic health record pilots were launched with the support of external technical and financial partners and suffer from a lack of sustainable funding or of an implementation mechanism, while a national digital health plan was technically validated and awaiting political validation; undated, so the date is the report's published date.
